meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据代码结构（而非文本）搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种编程语言。例如，找到所有带特定参数的函数，或将 console.log 替换为 logger.info。
howto.when: 当用户需要按代码形状（如函数、类、调用）进行查找或批量修改时触发。例如，要求“找到所有空 catch 块”或“把 require 改成 import”。

say.text: 把项目中所有 console.log 替换成 logger.info。
say.note: Claude 会先预览改动，确认后执行替换。

say.text: 找到所有空 catch 块。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出匹配的代码位置。

say.text: 把 Optional[X] 迁移成 X | None。
say.note: Claude 会按结构匹配并执行替换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code based on AST structure (not text) across 25 languages. For example, find all functions with a specific parameter or replace console.log with logger.info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to find or batch-modify code by shape (e.g., functions, classes, calls). For instance, 'find all empty catch blocks' or 'replace require with import'.

say_en.text: Replace all console.log with logger.info in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will preview changes first, then apply.
Claude will search and list matching locations.
Claude will match structurally and perform the rewrite.
